prospero.name: Prospero Patches
prospero.description: Looks up PlayStation 5 title IDs such as PPSA01628 or PPSA-01628 on PROSPEROPatches and shows the game's name, art and a link to its patch page.

showIcon.label: Show icon
showIcon.description: Show the game's icon. Art is fetched by your degoog server, so visitors never contact PROSPEROPatches.

showBackground.label: Show background art
showBackground.description: Show the game's background art as a banner above the title.

showLogo.label: Show logo
showLogo.description: Show the game's logo on the background art, for titles that have one on PROSPEROPatches. Needs the background art turned on.

showDetails.label: Show details
showDetails.description: List the region, current version and size of the latest patch.
